gaps.title: Role Mapping Incomplete: Missing 'Аспирант' to Researcher mapping
gaps.jtbd: When syncing Moodle roles, I want 'Аспирант' to map to the internal protocol access role, so that postgraduate students get the documented access level.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a Moodle role containing 'Аспирант', When mapMoodleRole is evaluated, Then it returns the 'RESEARCHER' internal role.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires 'Исследователь / Аспирант' to have protocol access (RESEARCHER). AuthController.mapMoodleRole checks for 'learner', 'student', and 'исследователь', but misses 'аспирант', causing these users to fall back to 'USER' without intended access.
